title: Make S2 task beds reproducibly materializable

preflight.note: Created before implementing S2 acquisition, projection, manifest, and offline verification.

acceptance_criteria.text: Both preregistered S2 beds acquire their immutable upstream assets and reject moving revisions or digest mismatches.
Every registered selector is validated exactly once against its actual source schema and has a safe model-facing projection separated from evaluation metadata.
Each bed produces a deterministic identity manifest and offline verification detects tampering independently of its materialization directory or timestamp.
All selected source repositories and base commits pass bounded resolution preflight, and no model or third-party payload is committed.
